title: Fourteen Summers and One Short Battery
subtitle: 人工智能 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 人工智能（科学与技术·人工智能与机器人）
meta: 主题语境：人工智能（科学与技术·人工智能与机器人）　|　核心词汇：drone　|　正文 342 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 drone 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 2004 my teacher ① flew a drone that no farmer in the field would have trusted, and he said the flying was the whole of the summer. The ② drone, meaning the machine and not the hum, ran fourteen summers and stayed unnamed in the book; a drone, he said, is the only thing in a field that is judged by how long it is left untrusted.

Every ③ drone in that field had the same short battery at the end of it, and the ④ drone at the end, meaning the one they kept for the mapping and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. A drone, my mother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to fly; my teacher said the flying is the part that fills fourteen summers.

My uncle meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the drone was the whole of the story, meaning the hum and not the machine. The ⑥ drone, meaning the hum and not any of that, is the only thing in a story that everybody hears and nobody looks for; drone, he said, is either something you fly or the only word that means both a machine and a hum. He said the hum is the part they remember.

By 2013 the ⑦ drone had become a line in a register, and the register had become an argument about the short battery. The ⑧ drone of the whole thing, my teacher wrote in July, was one field and fourteen summers of flying; drone, he said, is either the one at the end or the reason you learned to fly. She said the flying was never mentioned.

The ⑨ drone I remember is the one named in the register, which crashed in 2018 and is still described as the quietest in the field. A ⑩ drone, my mother said in 2020, is the only one that improves by being flown; every drone, she said, is a hum that has agreed to look like a machine. She said the hum was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 无人机（指那片田地上空飞过的那一架）
B. n. 无人机（指那架机器本身，与嗡嗡声相对）
C. 固定搭配：fly a drone 操控一架无人机
D. n. 无人机（指留给测绘用的那一架）
E. n. 无人机（抽象总称，指一支团队的用机之事）
F. n. 无人机（指登记表上写到、被列名的那一架）
G. n. 嗡嗡声（指故事里人人都听见却无人去找的那样东西）
H. n. 嗡嗡声（抽象总称，指人人都听见却无人去找的那种声音）

items.q: flew a drone that no farmer in the field would have trusted
The drone, meaning the machine and not the hum
the drone was the whole of the story
the drone had become a line in a register
The drone of the whole thing
A drone, my mother said in 2020

answers.why: fly a drone 意为“操控一架无人机”，2004 年老师操控了一架田地里没有一位农户肯信任的无人机。
drone 意为“无人机”，指那架机器本身而不是嗡嗡声，它经过了十四个夏天而在簿子上没有名字。
drone 意为“无人机”，指那片田地上的每一架无人机，每一架到头都有同一块小小的电池。
drone 意为“无人机”，指留给测绘用的那一架，是唯一有人谢过两次的。
drone 意为“嗡嗡声”，指故事里人人都听见却无人去找的那样东西，叔叔说这嗡嗡声就是那个故事的全部。
drone 意为“嗡嗡声”，指人人都听见却无人去找的那种声音而不是那架机器，是故事里人人都听见、却无人去找的东西。
drone 意为“无人机”，指登记表上写到、被列名的那一架，到 2013 年这架无人机成了登记表里的一行。
drone 意为“无人机”，老师七月写道，整件事的用机之事是一片田地和十四个夏天的飞行。
drone 意为“无人机”，我记得的是登记表上列名的那一架，2018 年摔了，至今仍被说成田地里最安静的一架。
drone 为抽象总称，母亲 2020 年说，一架无人机是唯一会因为被好好操控而变得更好的机器。
